text:
Noah Dobson is the defenseman Montreal is paying $9.5 million a year, and right now that number is in every headline about him. He has no goals and nine assists in 26 games, a last-minute giveaway against the Flyers got picked apart, and his coach was seen giving him a long talk on the bench during play (reported by RDS).

The results are worse than the play. Dobson has zero goals on 3.2 expected, and Montreal has scored 10.7 fewer goals than its chances deserve with him on the ice, which takes a lot of assists off a defenseman's line. That usually swings back. At five on five the Canadiens are about even in chance share with him out there, slightly better than when he sits.

The worry is older than this season. Evolving-Hockey had opponents generating noticeably more against him last season, bottom 5% among defensemen, while he faced top competition. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking flagged a lot of shots from the outside rather than the slot. Watch his chances against. His points should come back on their own; the defensive reputation is what he has to change.
headline: Dobson's results are worse than his play
